subject: A Maya glyph cartouche with a stylized profile mouth emitting a curling speech/breath scroll, plus a vertical row of small word-block rectangles and dots — naming and language.
A Maya glyph cartouche of an interlocking woven-mat (pop mat) pattern of cross-hatched panels meeting at the center, with a small dotted circle where they join — connection and interface.
A Maya glyph cartouche with a central round seal containing a four-petal quincunx cross, encircled by a ring of evenly spaced dots — an agreed, measured standard.
A Maya glyph cartouche with a stepped pyramid-mountain (witz) and a trail of footprints leading up it, a sun-eye with radiating dots above — a guiding path.
A Maya glyph cartouche showing a stylized human head in profile facing a small paneled interface block dotted with circles — people meeting interfaces.
A Maya glyph cartouche of a folded bark-paper codex with horizontal bands, a vertical row of dotted bullet marks down one side and small scroll corners — a written decree.
A Maya glyph cartouche filled with an orderly grid of cross-hatched woven cells and stacked bar elements, a few dots — structured machine-readable rules.
A Maya glyph cartouche of linked tubular scroll segments connected by interlocking spiral rosettes with a directional curl-arrow flowing through — an automated pipeline.
A Maya glyph cartouche of a stylized grasping hand (Maya hand sign) holding a simple tool, surrounded by small dots — capability and craft.
A Maya glyph cartouche with a large stylized eye above a paneled codex with cross-hatch and small check-like marks — examination and oversight.
A Maya glyph cartouche of an open banded codex with a curling speech/song scroll rising from its pages, a few dots — published storytelling.
A Maya glyph cartouche of two mirrored curling speech scrolls facing each other with a small dotted circle between them — dialogue.
A Maya glyph cartouche of a profile head emitting a large curling song scroll, with rows of small sound dots radiating outward — oratory and public speaking.
A Maya glyph cartouche with a stylized eye beside a star (Venus/ek) motif and rows of dotted data marks — inquiry and study.
A Maya glyph cartouche of a neat stack of folded bark-paper codex sheets with banded edges and one folded corner, cross-hatch panel — formal published papers.
A Maya glyph cartouche with a central profile teacher head on a woven-mat (gathering) base, flanked by two smaller profile heads and a pointer scroll — communal learning.
